name: gupy-jobs-scraper-brazil
title: Gupy Jobs Scraper Brazil (vagas de emprego Gupy)
description: Extract job openings from Gupy, Brazil's largest recruiting platform: title, company, city/state, remote/hybrid/on-site, publish date, deadline, PcD flag, skills and description. Filter by keyword, state, city, company, workplace type and recency. Fast HTTP-only, no browser.
